title: Creative Strategy
summary: Creative performance fell over the last seven days: 480k spend at 0.68 NC ROAS, higher NCCPA and a hit rate down to about 19%, so the team must diversify formats and speed up editors without losing quality. AVIA spent 29k at 0.46 NC ROAS and moves from the thyroid page to a general PDP and general CBO with broader angles, while Hashimoto's ads are tested carefully within compliance.
points: AVIA ad account verification is still pending, so Damian cannot launch there yet
Some editors take five to six days per video; the expectation is three to five a day with agentic editing
A senior video editor was hired to audit editors and roll out agentic workflows, aiming for 300+ concepts a week from 185
Creative relies too much on AI authority, AI UGC, Pixar and animated songs; interview-style, AI drama and ingredient stories are the next tests
Unassigned dashboard entries come from the Black Friday tag sitting after the AS code in ad names
Hashimoto's ads showed a low early CPA, but claims of replacing levothyroxine get disapproved
Low-quality AI voice and lip-sync videos are still being approved for launch
decisions: AVIA shifts to the general PDP and general CBO, with angles kept congruent with the page
Thyroid videos already started get finished; unstarted ones are stopped
Thyroid and Hashimoto's ads may cite cortisol and T4-to-T3 conversion but never claim to replace medication
Strategists reject poor-quality videos and escalate repeat offenders; editors who repeat mistakes are replaced
Tristan joins as a creative strategist with AVIA focus
